\section[(dialogue)]{Wanting, liking and having — a first pass}

\label{lesson:JA-R101-first-pass-wanting-liking-and-having}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a heated table and heating.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item wanted, a wish, to wish for, a request, a desire
  \item long-awaited, a prayer, an order, a candidate, a plan
  \item to like, a liking, a hobby, something to look forward to, love
  \item possible, good at, poor at, belongings, a rich person
  \item a qualification, talent, a technique, room to spare, convenience
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Wanted? (\textbf{\ja{ほしい}}, \emph{hoshii}.) A wish? (\textbf{\ja{ねがい}}, \emph{negai}.) To wish for? (\textbf{\ja{ねがう}}, \emph{negau}.) A request? (\textbf{\ja{たのみ}}, \emph{tanomi}.) A desire? (\textbf{\ja{よくぼう}}, \emph{yokubou}.) Long-awaited? (\textbf{\ja{まちどおしい}}, \emph{machidooshii}.) A prayer? (\textbf{\ja{いのり}}, \emph{inori}.) An order? (\textbf{\ja{ちゅうもん}}, \emph{chuumon}.) A candidate? (\textbf{\ja{こうほ}}, \emph{kouho}.) A plan? (\textbf{\ja{よてい}}, \emph{yotei}.) To like? (\textbf{\ja{このむ}}, \emph{konomu}.) A liking? (\textbf{\ja{このみ}}, \emph{konomi}.) A hobby? (\textbf{\ja{しゅみ}}, \emph{shumi}.) Something to look forward to? (\textbf{\ja{たのしみ}}, \emph{tanoshimi}.) Love? (\textbf{\ja{あい}}, \emph{ai}.) Possible? (\textbf{\ja{かのう}}, \emph{kanou}.) Good at? (\textbf{\ja{とくい}}, \emph{tokui}.) Poor at? (\textbf{\ja{にがて}}, \emph{nigate}.) Belongings? (\textbf{\ja{もちもの}}, \emph{mochimono}.) A rich person? (\textbf{\ja{おかねもち}}, \emph{okanemochi}.) A qualification? (\textbf{\ja{しかく}}, \emph{shikaku}.) Talent? (\textbf{\ja{さいのう}}, \emph{sainou}.) A technique? (\textbf{\ja{わざ}}, \emph{waza}.) Room to spare? (\textbf{\ja{よゆう}}, \emph{yoyuu}.) Convenience? (\textbf{\ja{つごう}}, \emph{tsugou}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Why, and things at home — a second pass}

\label{lesson:JA-R101-second-pass-why-and-things-at-home}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for property and a use.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item property, a use, a means, a method, a way of doing
  \item why, a reason, for the sake of; because of, the fault, a reason
  \item a wallet, a walking stick, a bag, a scrubbing brush, a dustpan
  \item rubbish, a stick, a board, scissors, a magazine
  \item a flag, a chest of drawers, a sliding door, a heated table, heating
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Property? (\textbf{\ja{ざいさん}}, \emph{zaisan}.) A use? (\textbf{\ja{つかいみち}}, \emph{tsukaimichi}.) A means? (\textbf{\ja{しゅだん}}, \emph{shudan}.) A method? (\textbf{\ja{ほうほう}}, \emph{houhou}.) A way of doing? (\textbf{\ja{やりかた}}, \emph{yarikata}.) Why? (\textbf{\ja{どうして}}, \emph{doushite}.) A reason? (\textbf{\ja{りゆう}}, \emph{riyuu}.) For the sake of; because of? (\textbf{\ja{ため}}, \emph{tame}.) The fault? (\textbf{\ja{せい}}, \emph{sei}.) A reason? (\textbf{\ja{ゆえ}}, \emph{yue}.) A wallet? (\textbf{\ja{さいふ}}, \emph{saifu}.) A walking stick? (\textbf{\ja{つえ}}, \emph{tsue}.) A bag? (\textbf{\ja{ふくろ}}, \emph{fukuro}.) A scrubbing brush? (\textbf{\ja{たわし}}, \emph{tawashi}.) A dustpan? (\textbf{\ja{ちりとり}}, \emph{chiritori}.) Rubbish? (\textbf{\ja{ごみ}}, \emph{gomi}.) A stick? (\textbf{\ja{ぼう}}, \emph{bou}.) A board? (\textbf{\ja{いた}}, \emph{ita}.) Scissors? (\textbf{\ja{はさみ}}, \emph{hasami}.) A magazine? (\textbf{\ja{ざっし}}, \emph{zasshi}.) A flag? (\textbf{\ja{はた}}, \emph{hata}.) A chest of drawers? (\textbf{\ja{たんす}}, \emph{tansu}.) A sliding door? (\textbf{\ja{ふすま}}, \emph{fusuma}.) A heated table? (\textbf{\ja{こたつ}}, \emph{kotatsu}.) Heating? (\textbf{\ja{だんぼう}}, \emph{danbou}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
